blocks.text: Status: Proposed; independent of the story archive.
Real-world basis: Rainshadow valleys, seasonally dry tropical forests, oasis canyons, and monsoon edges.
World relation: Wild and Crafted World traditions.
Discovery: A dry canyon contains leaves wet on only one side. Following the wet sides leads through a narrow seam into dense forest.

Mini timeline: Era Zero — Two adjacent climate systems share groundwater while keeping opposite surface weather. Era One — Optimization separates them and weakens both. Era Two — Emergency folding reconnects the water but misaligns rainfall. Era Three — The jungle receives rain only as shadows cast by storms occurring in the neighboring desert.
Present condition: Viable, unusual, and sensitive to changes in the desert beyond the seam.
Corruption: 4 by origin, 1 in current stability.
Aesthetic brief: Dry orange canyon foreground, dense green jungle beyond a sharp light boundary, rain visible only inside cloud shadows, and roots crossing beneath both.
Metaphorical function: Two places can depend on one another without sharing the same visible conditions.
